deck_rule: choose one visual_style per deck; vary diagram_type within that style

clean_flat_vector.prompt_anchor: clean flat vector technical illustration; precise geometry; crisp sans-serif labels; restrained Sophia palette; generous whitespace; no sketch texture

excalidraw_hand_drawn.prompt_anchor: hand-drawn Excalidraw-style technical diagram; rough rounded outlines; marker-like strokes; casual handwritten-style labels; soft flat fills; premium and legible

blueprint_technical.prompt_anchor: blueprint-style technical schematic; dark or pale technical drawing field; thin precise linework; grid discipline; labeled callouts; restrained accent color

soft_editorial_3d.prompt_anchor: soft editorial 3D technical composition; matte materials; shallow but legible depth; diagrammatic layout; no glossy plastic; labels remain crisp

dashboard_data_story.prompt_anchor: high-end dashboard/data-story visual; modular panels; clear metric hierarchy; restrained chart forms; dense but readable; no generic SaaS gradients
